# Hatchfield Sim API (llms.txt)

Compact reference for agents. Load this instead of full source when possible.

## Core Concepts

- Fixed-timestep simulation tick (not frame-rate based).
- Pure TypeScript sim — no DOM or Three.js imports in core logic.
- Serializable state (flights, economy, research must survive save/load).

## Key Surfaces

- `tick(dt)` — advance simulation by fixed delta.
- `getState()` / `loadState(json)` — full serializable snapshot.
- `window.__hatch` (debug only) — exposed when `?playtest=1`.
- Pathfinding heap, turnaround classes, aircraft rules live under `src/game/`.

## Rules

- Never import Three.js or React inside `src/game/sim*`.
- Prefer reading this file + targeted QMD/symbol lookup over full file loads.

Fill in exact function signatures as the sim stabilizes.
